summary: Design v6 beats the one-prompt baseline on dev and holds on the harder EngSAF benchmark (0.158 vs 0.179). Stress test found the generous v2b easy to fool; the form gate lifted it from 0.67 to 0.86 (baseline 0.81). Held-out test split not run yet.

stages.desc: CS and networking short answers: DigiKlausur, SAF, Mohler

steps.name: Set up
steps.note: Project folders, config file, model client with Claude CLI and API backends, 26 tests.

steps.name: Load data
steps.note: DigiKlausur, SAF and Mohler downloaded and loaded into one format; dev/test split by question.

steps.name: Baseline
steps.note: One-prompt grader and metrics script. First number to beat, from 24 DigiKlausur answers.

steps.name: Marking scheme maker
steps.note: Schemes written once per question and self-tested. 8 of 8 passed on DigiKlausur dev.

steps.name: Grader and checks
steps.note: Read-first pass, essence policy, code prices verdicts (partial = 0.9), schemes sized to the model answer. v2b error 0.069 on DigiKlausur seed 0 vs 0.217 baseline.

steps.name: Feedback and its checker
steps.note: Feedback judge run on 2 runs: anchored 96%, names the missed point 100%, actionable 95-100%, but explains why only 33-55%.

steps.name: Readable report page
steps.note: Per-run report.html with equations, numbered reading order, score sum, teacher mark vs ours. Sample view: autograde view --name <run> --limit 10.

steps.name: Improvement loop
steps.note: Batch 1 done (v0 to v2b, see experiments/RESULTS.md). Next: feedback explains why; Mohler still strict.

steps.name: Final held-out run
steps.note: Run once on test questions, then write the results table.

next.s: Read the comparison tabs. Critique scored best on the judge; hints leak least of the model answer.
Owner writes the rubrics. A loader for them is not built yet.

next.t: Run the held-out test split once
next.s: Baseline vs final design on the test questions of all three datasets.
Confident wrong answers still earn part marks 3 times in 6 in the stress test.
RiceChem needs an access request by the owner. ProcessBench for step-by-step maths is the open option.

issues.t: Settings were chosen on dev samples
issues.s: Partial weight 0.9, sized schemes and the form gate were tuned on dev samples. EngSAF was not tuned on.
Three markings by the same model gave identical marks on every answer. A cheaper second model is used as a review flag.
Short engineering answers marked 0 to 2. It tests domain shift and noisy marks, not multi-step reasoning.
The feedback judge is a Claude model, so quality scores are probably a little generous.

decisions.t: Fully automatic, no human step at run time
Plain Python, no LangGraph for now
Output format: file per student or table
Git: every GT test is committed and tagged locally
Push to GitHub: manual, when you choose
